brief.topic: A portfolio project that proves AI PM skill in one weekend
constraints: Example scores are illustrative and labelled on screen and in caption

coreInsight: A small project that defines a task, builds a 30-case eval set, compares two approaches and ends in a written decision shows AI PM judgment better than a polished demo.

body:
The weekend project:
→ Pick one narrow task you know well
→ Write 30 test cases with clear pass rules
→ Run two approaches on all 30
→ Write a one-page memo: what you’d ship, the risks, and why
Illustrative example: sorting support emails by urgency. Prompt only: 21 of 30. With examples: 26 of 30. Ship the second, route misses to a human.
Link the test cases and the memo, not just a screenshot.
caption.cta: Save this for your next free weekend.

claims.text: A small project with a defined task, an eval set, a comparison of two approaches and a written decision demonstrates AI PM judgment better than a demo alone.
Prompt only 21 of 30 vs with examples 26 of 30 on an email-urgency task.
